mentions.name: Parity-protected data archive tool
mentions.description: This app protects data archives and data collections by adding parity, letting stored files survive a degree of bitrot, particularly for files not kept on a NAS. It is one of three apps built with a Zig core, C FFI, and Windows/Mac frontends.
mentions.problem: Files not necessarily stored on a NAS can suffer bitrot over time; the app adds parity so data collections can survive a degree of it.
mentions.source_excerpt: Another protects data archives/data collections with some parity, in order to survive a degree of bitrot, for those files that you don't necessarily have on a NAS.
